The first six columns give \Rfive{} on the clean video, with the evidence frames ($E$) or as many frames outside the interval ($O$) masked or swapped, and on all-black versions of these questions. The $\Delta$ columns give trained-minus-base changes in points in two readouts (Appendix~\ref{app:regen}). The evidence share is $1-a_E/a_O$, with $a_E$ and $a_O$ the \Rfive{} under the evidence edit and under the placebo edit, and is given under swap and under mask. \emph{Follows} is the fraction of the audit questions both models localise on which the prediction, regenerated after the event's frames are exchanged with another block, has IoU $\ge0.5$ with the moved interval; Table~\ref{tab:audit} gives it for the Qwen2.5-VL-7B models. Table~\ref{tab:s3} gives answering and refusal on black videos over the full test split. Brackets give 95\% intervals.}
